# Event Attendee & Visitor Badge Sticker Template

## Visitor Identification & Conference Badge Template

Temporary adhesive visitor badges for security check-in desks.

### Layout Spec
```html
<div class="visitor-badge" style="width: 99.1mm; height: 67.7mm; border: 2px solid #004d99; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4mm; box-sizing: border-box;">
  <div style="background: #004d99; color: #fff; padding: 2mm; text-align: center; font-weight: bold;">
    VISITOR PASS — GUEST ACCESS
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 4mm;">
    <div style="font-size: 16pt; font-weight: 900;">Bikash Shrestha</div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt; color: #555;">Everest Tech Ventures</div>
  </div>
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 6mm;">
    <span>DATE: 2026-09-28</span>
    <span>HOST: Engineering Dept</span>
  </div>
</div>
```
Recommended SKU: **ST-8 A4100** (8 labels/sheet).
